incoming.name: Tourism
incoming.excerpt: A number of inland destinations, such as the English Lake District, and Snowdonia appealed to those who liked the countryside and fine scenery.

outgoing.name: Agriculture
outgoing.excerpt: Whilst most of the land is either open or mountainous land, there is a significant amount of agricultural activity within the Park.

outgoing.name: English language
outgoing.excerpt: The English name for the area derives from Snowdon, which is the highest mountain in Wales at 1085 metres (3560 feet).
